notes: Quotes from an archive.org scan of the maker's own printed manual are taken from the scan's OCR text layer (the item's _djvu.txt), byte for byte; where a quoted sentence wraps in the scan, the two OCR lines are joined with one space. The archive.org scan of the maker's document counts as primary. Document: 'Channel F System II' built-in games (Tennis, Hockey) instruction sheet, Fairchild Video Products (archive.org item fairchild-channel-f-system-ii-built-in-games-instructions). No System II owner's manual scan was found.

Partial facts not filed: the sheet names 'the five Selector Control buttons on the Game Console' and 'the two Hand-Controller units', and a 'Reset' button; whether Reset is one of the five is not stated, so no controls list.

Envelope: none found. The Strong National Museum of Play record (Google Arts & Culture asset dAGl7Qu8aSGkmQ, 'Type: Console Hardware', 'Date Created: 1979', medium includes printed cardboard, i.e. boxed) publishes no dimensions. No CHM System II record found.
external_ids: Wikidata Q61827727 via the Wikidata API (no P5795 on it); igdb_platform 'fairchild-channel-f' is the P5795 of the Channel F platform item Q1053294, which the System II plays.
